main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.issue record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless issue create` does, and a dev.knotless.label record about it when labels are chosen: refused, with the template, when the repository has one (see dev.knotless.getTemplate) and the body follows none of it. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

body.description: What it is about, in Markdown.

images.description: Pictures uploaded with dev.knotless.uploadImage; those the body links to are attached.

labels.description: Labels to put on it as it opens, as dev.knotless.labelItem would: refused, with nothing written, when one is not the repository's or not the account's to put on.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

description: Opens an issue on a repository, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
